description: This file contains C# source code for a set of unit tests targeting ADO.NET client stream functionality across multiple database systems, including SQL Server, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. It defines test classes both for each specific database and an abstract base class with shared setup and configuration logic. The file makes use of testing frameworks such as Xunit, and it includes configurations for host and client setup, database connection initialization, and specific test cases related to stream drops.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for SQL Server ADO.NET client stream functionality, inherits from AdoNetClientStreamTests and provides specific setup for SQL Server.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for MySQL ADO.NET client stream functionality, inherits from AdoNetClientStreamTests and implements specific setup for MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for PostgreSQL ADO.NET client stream functionality, inherits from AdoNetClientStreamTests and sets up PostgreSQL-specific configuration.

classes.name: AdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Abstract base class for ADO.NET client stream tests encompassing setup, configuration, and shared test logic for different databases.

methods.description: Asynchronous initialization method that sets up the database connection for testing and initializes the test runner.

methods.description: Configures the test cluster with silo and client builder configurations.
